title: Training, group photos, OpenAI photo detail, wearable recovery, Starter, personality, reminders, cards, voices, and more
summary: Training shows saved workouts; generated images can become group photos on request; Luna, Terra, and Sol on OpenAI review one first photo more closely; health settings, workout timing, and wearable recovery are clearer; Starter waits until used; personality stays editable; referrals stay in their chat; reminders keep local time; cards and voices stay clear; search is current.
